comment: SPA rewrite + security response headers for Vercel. Mirrors public/_headers (Netlify/Cloudflare) and the index.html <meta> CSP. No third-party origins: Tailwind, fonts, icons and html2pdf are all bundled, so nothing is fetched cross-origin at runtime. Supabase is the only remote the app talks to. The localhost:54321 dev entries from the meta CSP are intentionally omitted here.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; media-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; connect-src 'self' https://*.supabase.co wss://*.supabase.co; worker-src 'self' blob:; manifest-src 'self'
